name: Beatoven.ai
tagline: Beatoven.ai generates unique, royalty-free background music customised to the mood and pace of your video or podcast. Users select a genre, mood, and duration, and the AI composes original tracks that adapt dynamically to content sections. YouTubers, filmmakers, and game developers use it to avoid copyright issues.
